translation.title: Ciclopirox Olamine Scalp Solution
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for seborrheic dermatitis.
translation.usage: Use this medicine 2 to 3 times a week, or whenever needed when treating a scalp condition. Wet your hair with water, apply enough of the solution to work up a lather, and massage it in thoroughly with your fingertips. After 3 to 5 minutes, rinse your hair several times with water so that it is washed out completely.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or to any of its ingredients. Do not apply it to the eyes or the area around the eyes, mucous membranes (such as the mouth, inside of the nose or vagina), the genital area, or to areas with eczema, weeping (oozing) skin, erosion (raw skin), cracks or severe wounds; if it accidentally gets into any of these areas, rinse completely with plenty of water, and consult a doctor or pharmacist if irritation continues. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have experienced allergic reactions to this medicine or its ingredients (such as rash, redness, itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer), if you or your family have an allergic constitution, if the affected area is on the face or is widespread, if the affected area is festering (has pus), if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, for children under 12, or if you are under a doctor's care. This medicine is for external use on the scalp and adjacent areas only. Follow the directed dose and schedule exactly. Do not use it when the affected area or its surroundings are dirty. For children, use it under the supervision of a guardian. Keep it away from open flames. Adverse reactions such as skin irritation or erosion, and commonly itching, a burning feeling, redness or a rash at the application site, and rarely hypersensitivity at the application site, skin peeling, eczema, hair loss, hair discoloration or changes in hair texture may occur; if they do, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, keep out of reach of children, and keep away from fire.
